system.description: The pinnacle of the path, this power restores a degree of mental acuity to the biothaumaturge's creations, granting them Mental Traits equal to what they had in life minus one (never below one) while remaining loyal to their creator. These creations can reason or scheme, and the biothaumaturge may change their standing orders at any time, which they will immediately obey. The process takes three weeks of work following a successful Static Mental Challenge.
